semantics.required_review: Expected for this archetype unless explicit project evidence makes it not applicable.
semantics.conditional: Only materialize as required work when its condition is true; otherwise record unresolved/not-applicable.
semantics.recommended: Strong default to evaluate but not a project requirement without scope evidence.
semantics.not_applicable: Explicitly evaluated and excluded from completion accounting.
